translation.title: Terbinafine Hydrochloride Single-Application Topical Solution
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for athlete's foot (tinea pedis), a skin fungal infection caused by dermatophytes.
translation.usage: Before use, wash the affected area clean and dry it completely, then apply a sufficient amount just once so that the affected area and its surroundings are thoroughly wetted. Even on the foot that shows no lesions, spread a thin layer on both feet — between all the toes, over the entire sole and up to about 1.5 cm above the sole — and let it dry for 1 to 2 minutes. Do not rub the medicine in when applying it. Wash your hands clean after use. For the best effect, leave the treated skin unwashed for 24 hours after application. If there is no sign of improvement after 1 week, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
translation.caution: Do not use this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, if you are breastfeeding, or in infants and children. Before using it, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to propylene glycol. Do not use an occlusive dressing or wrapping unless directed by a doctor. This medicine is for external use only. Do not use it in the eyes, on the cornea or conjunctiva; if it gets into the eyes, rinse them out completely with plenty of water. Do not use it on the face, nails, scalp, around the mouth, on the vaginal area, or on cracked or eroded (raw, oozing) areas. Stop use immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if adverse reactions occur, such as hives, redness, erythema (red spots), itching, irritation, local contact dermatitis, skin peeling, stinging or a burning feeling of the skin.
